study: ten-seed paired S1 upper-tail and ROI-migration audit
event_weighting: Within each seed, nuclear model, and 1-keV true-energy stratum, event i receives w_i = R_bin_exact * f(E_i) / sum_j f(E_j), where f(E)=grid.interpolate(E,xs,ys) and R_bin_exact is read from that seed's original fold response-by-energy-bin CSV. This exactly reproduces the original fold's event-weight normalization; GCN and JJ55 are folded separately.

stratum_weight_closure.tolerance: 5e-12 relative to exact per-bin integrated rate
stratum_weight_closure.required_identity: sum_i w_i = R_bin_exact for every seed, nuclear model, and 1-keV stratum

pairing: Each event shares the same NR quanta, true recoil energy, true position, and S2 draw between Parametric and Full S1; the two S1 response modes use separate deterministic NEST random streams.
s1_coincidence: Pinned NEST GetS1 sign/pass flag; no substitute threshold is imposed.

black_support_selection_audit.interpretation: Every event in the ten-seed black support passes both S1 coincidence flags, the NEST S2 threshold, the strict raw-S2 lower cut, and the corrected-S2 window. Thus the WS-ROI acceptance in this support is identical to the S1 [3,600] phd acceptance; the Parametric/Full rate difference is driven by S1 migration, not S2 selection.

bootstrap.unit: independent production seed; paired Parametric/Full maps remain together
bootstrap.interpretation: cluster bootstrap interval for descriptive histogram TV, not a detector-systematic interval or formal equivalence proof

uncertainty_interpretation: Student-t intervals are based on the ten independent production-level seed estimates. Bootstrap intervals resample whole paired seeds. Neither includes NEST model uncertainty, detector calibration uncertainty, or official LZ waveform/selection covariance.
spatial_prior: Uniform active-TPC cylinder proxy from the source production; not the official 4.71-tonne fiducial-volume or calibration-source geometry.
limitations: NEST Full S1 is a PMT/time-window response model, not official LZ waveform-level reconstruction.
The S1-only [3,600] phd acceptance is reported separately from the full WS ROI, which also uses the common S2 threshold and S2c/S2raw boundaries.
DAQ trigger, SS reconstruction, data-analysis cuts, official fiducial-volume mask, Skin/OD veto, and live-time migration are not included.
The 1-phd quantile histogram and 10-phd TV histogram are descriptive summaries; the native event samples remain the primary record.
Ten independent seeds quantify production-level Monte Carlo variation but do not establish Parametric/Full statistical equivalence.
No detector-systematic covariance or profile likelihood is constructed.
